answer_1.quote: KBQG generates natural language questions according to a set of facts extracted from KB ...

answer_2.quote: We adopt BLEU-n (n = 1-4) and ROUGE-L as automatic evaluation metrics ...

answer_4.quote: We hire three people to evaluate the relevance and fluency of the generated questions ... We invite 6 annotators to score each generated question ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each generated question on fluency and relevance using a five-point Likert scale (1 = poor, 5 = perfect).
